transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. For the past year, I've been experiencing an incredibly high, euphoric mood and just overflowing with physical and mental energy all the time. It feels like I have a constant surge of energy that I can't turn off, which is why I decided to come in today.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever experienced symptoms severe enough to require hospitalization, or have you noticed a complete inability to function in your daily life or work?
No, I have never been hospitalized because of this. As for whether it completely stops me from functioning, I'm not quite sure how to answer that.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing or seeing things that others could not, or held beliefs that were clearly not based in reality?
No, I've never seen or heard things that aren't actually there. However, I do strongly believe that I am an exceptionally special person with a grand, unique mission to fulfill in this life.

Has this intense period of energy and your belief about having a unique mission caused significant problems in your relationships or led to noticeable changes in your work or social life that others have pointed out to you?
To be honest, I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really thought about how it has affected my relationships or work, so I can't say if it has caused any major problems.
Regarding this high-energy state, has it lasted for at least four consecutive days, or has it persisted for a week or longer?
Yes, it has lasted much longer than just a week. In fact, I have been feeling this constant high energy and vitality every single day for about 12 months now.
In addition to these long-lasting periods of high energy, have you ever experienced significant periods of feeling deeply depressed, hopeless, or losing interest in almost all activities?
No, I haven't really experienced those periods of deep depression or hopelessness. I don't lose interest in things; if anything, I feel the exact opposite.

Given that you have had persistent, elevated energy for a year without periods of depression or functional collapse, are you currently taking any medications, or have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a chronic mood condition like Cyclothymic Disorder?
No, I am not currently taking any medications. I have also never been diagnosed with cyclothymic disorder or any other chronic mood condition by a doctor before.
Have you been using any substances, such as stimulants, caffeine in very high amounts, or other drugs, that might be contributing to this persistent surge of energy?
No, I don't use any stimulants, excessive caffeine, or other drugs at all. This high energy is just how I feel naturally without taking anything.
Do you find that you need significantly less sleep than usual to feel fully rested, or are you able to go for days with very little sleep without feeling tired?
I haven't really noticed any unusual changes in my sleep patterns. I think my sleep has been pretty normal, so I'm not really sure about that.

Since you mentioned believing you have a grand, unique mission, have you found yourself engaging in any unusual or risky activities—like spending large amounts of money, starting many new projects, or acting in ways that might seem impulsive or out of character to your friends or family?

Yes, I've actually been starting a lot of new projects and activities all at the same time because I feel this constant, overflowing need to keep moving and doing things. However, I find myself constantly jumping from one task to another without actually finishing any of them.
